scope: Opt-in contract, metadata preparation and approval disclosure before source binding and host execution
evidence_policy: Fresh exact candidate checks and actual separate-invocation review govern component completion. This descriptive JSON supplies no public capability, parent or work-chunk pass.
controls: Introduce separate opt-in models.download proposal data and v11 preview. Preserve exact v1-v10 semantics/fingerprints and default denial. Existing source metadata consent is not transfer or ModelWrite approval.

Require normalized immutable safe-format source/pin/metadata digest/license, explicit canonical public HTTPS origins including Hugging Face, existing file/byte bounds and an explicit bounded duration. Origins are proposed transfer scope, not supplier authority or a bypass of native DNS/redirect/integrity policy.

Prepare source metadata through the existing source owner under copied original organization/principal/client/host/workspace/current source-read policy, independently recompute/compare canonical source and digest and freeze copied preparation. Active objects, substitutions and revocation cannot yield preparation or invoke hooks.

The preparation compiler has no transaction, filesystem, runtime, task or registry port. Future hosts must do provider IO before their owned proposal transaction and bind exact data privately there; a prepared object is not approval.

Both popup/chat approval and whole-plan/per-change modes disclose exact model/version/license/sites/files/bytes/duration, an estimated temporary disk amount and separate Model-list/loading/training/publication authority. Provider labels are escaped text. Unknown/non-open licenses are allowed as declared data without rights.

Actual host, stored proposal and step support remains disabled. Existing saved-source/step validation denies the new operation rather than falling into generic system writes. No new tool, transfer, model load, registry save, supplier, dependency or paid call is enabled.

Transfer scope is explicitly public-without-credentials. Saved Hugging Face access is for metadata checks; the qualified file path sends no credentials. Private/gated transfer stays unavailable pending an approved secure seam. Byte/time checks do not promise physical stop: uncertain native IO retains an unconfirmed outcome.
focused_observations: Sixteen new contract cases cover detached bounded data, explicit capability denial, hostile/extra/private/effect fields, origin/resource/pin/format restrictions, declared unknown/non-open licensing, both approval-view codecs, forged/missing permission limits, changed identity and duplicate cache-target denial.

Ten golden preview SHA256 values were captured from clean primary rebuild8e370e648 before changes, using deterministic synthetic fixtures. The new parser preserved every v1-v10 preview byte-exact; the candidate was not used to regenerate the expected values.

Nine preparation cases use the actual source-preview application owner with a controlled provider fixture. They cover actor/source-read refusal before provider work, active raw/authority/result values without hook execution, copied payload/original callback identity across held metadata, actor/host/business retirement, provider/request digest and target substitution, independent response validation and non-open metadata preservation.

Four real DOM scenarios exercise popup/chat and whole-plan/per-change approval, sixteen interaction flows in total: unknown, open, non-open and a mixed Model/system plan with an escaped malicious label. They open the actual shared dialog, inspect precise permissions/limits/sites/files, switch approval mode and assert exact view/revision decisions. No image/script node is created from the label.

Early focused diagnostics found a credential-assignment label was not covered by the existing known-token recognizer; the new free-text label now explicitly rejects credential assignments. Type-only fixture overload/narrowing issues were corrected. An early routing assertion wrongly required generic fallback despite an existing legitimate shared profile; it now verifies no automatic Model borrowing plus unknown-path fallback.

Independent preflight corrected two disclosure claims: metadata-only saved access must not be described as transfer authentication, and deadline enforcement must not promise confirmed physical stop. A fixed public-without-credentials preview field is reconstructed by both approval codecs; missing or changed authentication scope refuses. UI checks preserve private/gated unavailability and uncertain-stop wording. No credential transport or native policy was added.

Expanded strict types passed. Related Context plan/save compatibility first failed in the restricted filesystem fixture environment; the exact permitted-local rerun passed all106cases without application changes or guard waivers. The related browser profile passed6cases. UI byte-count assertions account for locale grouping separators while still checking the exact selected/estimated numeric quantities.
qualification_limits: No actual host capability or provider/weight transfer, durable source-plan binding, job/registration/status/reveal integration, model loading/accuracy, native resource/restart or parent criterion/chunk is claimed.

Provider fixtures prove application preparation and source correlation, not live Hugging Face or a loadable model. DOM approval scenarios prove shared interaction and disclosure, not paired real-host or actual human authorization.

Temporary storage is an estimate, not native reservation/hard quota. Existing memory/storage/native/offload controls and all earlier failed history remain intact. Accepted model accuracy is not rerun.

Primary receipt/archive capacity still prevents importing isolated completed work. Preserve immutable history and existing bounds; versioned reports do not replace missing primary current-candidate receipts. Final combined qualification remains pending.

Public-file access is a supported transfer profile, not proof that a proposed repository is accessible without authentication. Private/gated acquisition and a secure download credential seam are not qualified or enabled.
